- `MstResult` now returns its selected edges as an immutable `List<Edge>`, which removes the last defensive-copy boilerplate. [MstResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/025_kruskals_mst/MstResult.java#L3)
- `KruskalMST` now operates directly on lists, so the solver logic is isolated from input conversion and result wrapping. [KruskalMST.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/025_kruskals_mst/KruskalMST.java#L5)
- The test harness now checks source-list isolation and immutability of both graph edges and result edges. [KruskalMSTTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/025_kruskals_mst/KruskalMSTTest.java#L64)
